messages:
maria: Heads-up: staging apply hung at 'Acquiring state lock' after a bunch of provider 429s. Anyone able to help?

jon: :eyes: can you paste the apply output and which provider?

maria: aws provider. here's tail of apply: ```Error: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
  on modules/db/main.tf line 42, in resource "aws_db_instance" "main":
  42: resource "aws_db_instance" "main" {}

provider aws: request throttled. retrying (attempt 4/5)
... then stuck acquiring state lock```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: workspace 'staging' terraform apply failed; auto-notify sent to infra channel

sam: We saw this last week. Usually racey provider calls + high parallelism keeps retries busy and the lock times out. Try `terraform apply -parallelism=1` and force-unlock if needed.

jon: If the apply never reached a finalize step, the lock may linger. `terraform force-unlock LOCK_ID` is ok if you're sure no one else is applying.

maria: Lock ID is `ba3f2c9e-8f4a-4b1d-9d7c-1234567890ab` I want to avoid force-unlock if there are partial creates. Any way to check partially created aws resources?

sam: Run `terraform state list` to see tracked resources. For AWS check console for db instances in creating state. If created, `terraform import` the resource address then `terraform state rm`/`terraform taint` accordingly.

jon: Also try `terraform init -upgrade` — provider bug fixes helped us before. And reduce parallelism for apply + bump provider retries by setting env `TF_RETRY_COUNT=5` (we set this in our CI wrapper).

maria: Ok will try -parallelism=1. Quick Q: can we also add `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` to the db module to reduce thrash?

sam: `create_before_destroy` helps for replacements, won't fix throttling. Add `timeouts` on the resource to increase create timeout if AWS is slow. Also consider rate-limit friendly backoff in our provider wrapper.

maria: Ran apply with -parallelism=1, it made progress but then failed on import step. Did `terraform force-unlock` and `terraform apply` resumed. :thumbsup: Will open a small PR to pin provider and add apply smoke check in CI.

jon: Nice. Can you paste the PR link when ready? We should also add a short blurb in runbook about provider throttling + parallelism.

maria: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/merge_requests/123 :sparkles: Adding docs in runbook now.

sam: Thanks — if it reoccurs tag me and I'll help dig provider logs. :eyes:
